name: Project: Home!
source:
Fired from your city job and with nowhere else to go, you return to your sleepy coastal hometown of Cabo Lagoon, inheriting your parents' old childhood home. The catch? A recent storm has left it a dilapidated, sand-filled wreck. With little money and even less handyman experience, the task of rebuilding your life from the ground up seems impossible.

That is, until you run into Mira and Lola—your childhood friends who have grown up into two stunning, but very different, women. Now successful renovation partners, the energetic and flirty Mira believes a home should be a high-tech haven of comfort, while the meticulous and sweet Lola champions cozy aesthetics and timeless design. They offer their expertise, and soon, your project becomes a collaborative labor of love. 

[From [url=https://sei-ren.itch.io/project-home]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你被城市工作解雇了，无处可去，你回到了沉睡的沿海家乡卡波泻湖，继承了父母童年时的老家。收获是什么？最近的一场风暴使它成为一片破败、布满沙子的残骸。由于钱很少，勤杂工经验更少，从头开始重建生活的任务似乎是不可能的。

也就是说，直到你遇到米拉和洛拉——你儿时的朋友，现在已经成长为两个令人惊叹但又截然不同的女人。如今，精力充沛、性感迷人的米拉 (Mira) 已成为成功的装修合作伙伴，她认为家应该是高科技舒适的天堂，而细致而甜美的洛拉 (Lola) 则倡导舒适的美学和永恒的设计。他们提供他们的专业知识，很快，你的项目就变成了爱的协作劳动。

[来自[url=https://sei-ren.itch.io/project-home]itch.io[/url]]
